title: BREAKING: United ISD Police Arrest David Sarli on Assault Charge
excerpt: BREAKING: United ISD police arrested David Sarli late Tuesday morning on a charge of assault causing bodily injury (Class A misdemeanor), executed on warrant #2026015415. Bond was set at $5,000 in case #PFCC26-003309L1. An arrest is an allegation; the accused is presumed innocent.
content:
BREAKING — United Independent School District police arrested David Sarli late Tuesday morning, October 20, 2026, on an assault charge, according to Webb County booking records.

Sarli was arrested at 11:33 a.m. and booked into the Webb County Jail (Booking #202608893) on one count of assault causing bodily injury, a Class A misdemeanor under Texas law. The arrest was executed on warrant #2026015415, and the case is numbered PFCC26-003309L1. Bond was set at $5,000, cash or bail surety.

A Class A misdemeanor in Texas is punishable by up to one year in jail and a fine of up to $4,000. The booking and court records reviewed by Webb Watch 956 do not describe the alleged incident, and they do not state where it allegedly occurred; the arresting agency is the United ISD Police Department.

Webb Watch 956 will follow case #PFCC26-003309L1 as it moves through the Webb County courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. David Sarli is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Booking #202608893, Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal (Case #PFCC26-003309L1; Warrant #2026015415).

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
